data.content: # Albania vs Finland Prediction: Honours Even in a Cagey Contest. ## Albania vs Finland: Prediction for the match on 12 November 2026. Finland will travel to the Air Albania Stadium to battle it out with Albania in the Nations League League C Group 1. Albania will be hoping to finish in first place, with the group winners advancing directly to League B, while the runners-up will enter the promotion play-offs. Finland will be hoping to stand firm in front of Albania's sold-out home supporters. Albania secured a 2-1 win over San Marino about five weeks ago, having led 1-0 at half-time. Before that, Albania lost 2-1 away to Finland, having earlier secured a 3-0 away win over San Marino. They also defeated Belarus 2-0 at home, recording 2.03 xG as they showed they could get a winning performance in front of their home supporters. Earlier still, Albania suffered a 2-1 defeat at Poland in the World Cup qualification play-off semi-final, and they will be hoping to avoid another narrow defeat here.

data.title: Dan Lanning Breaks Down Decision Behind Current Offensive Line Rotation - Sports Illustrated
data.content: The Oregon Ducks offensive line found a rhythm after plenty of ups and downs and coach Dan Lanning's preseason promise of a six to eight player rotation. It's no secret that the No. 23 Oregon Ducks (5-3 overall, 4-1 Big Ten) have struggled throughout the 2026 regular season with finding a successful lineup in the offensive trenches, particularly in the tackle slots. However, it seems that the 34-26 win over Northwestern at Autzen Stadium finally solidified the front five, with the Ducks utilizing their first consecutive starting group this year to produce the fourth-highest overall offensive yards of the season, second-highest passing yards of the season, and a season-low zero offensive penalties for a much-needed win. There's also the factor of injuries pursuing throughout the season that could impact Oregon's current trench rotation. "You talk about winning the line of scrimmage, and some of those were just necessary reps to get us to the point to where we felt like we had that.
